title: Second-ideal quotients of coherent formal modules are adic
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, I and K quasi-coherent ideal sheaves, and M a coherent I-adic formal module [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module]. For each e ≥ 0 the inverse system in n with terms M_n/K^(e+1)M_n and induced transitions is a coherent I-adic formal module, with positive I-level n represented by n+1.

source.place: Tag 088A, construction of G_e and their adjacent quotient maps

proof.text: Each K-quotient term is coherent by formalCompletionSystem_coherent applied to the coherent term of M.

Multiplication by I^(n+1) on a K-quotient is zero: use idealModuleProduct_quotient_comp_zero_iff to check this after its epimorphic projection, and use annihilation of the original term. The product inclusion is monic, hence its zero map gives a zero product object.

For adjacent n, use the canonical quotient interchange isomorphism of grothendieckDevissage_secondAdicSystem_comparison, followed by the K-quotient of the defining adjacent I-quotient isomorphism of M. Cancel the K-quotient projection; the interchange projection identity and the original adjacent quotient identity give the actual transition.
